title: 第5章 也得给本公子敬酒！
slug: 皇家县令我每日躺着收税
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

捕快苦涩一笑，摊了摊手，“可，可他是县令啊。”

“县令？”钱世康一愣，忍不住又回头看了眼张宁，语气不似之前那么自信了。

但依旧嘴硬，还不自觉挺直了腰，“县，县令又怎么了？就算是县令，到了这荒山县，也得给本公子敬酒！”

乾国的王法姓张。

但荒山县的王法，至少得有一部分姓钱。

哪个新来的县令，到了荒山县，不得先去钱家拜拜码头？

捕快有些不敢置信地瞪大眼，“钱公子当真不知，这位县令的来头？”

“区区一个流水的县令，本公子为什么要知道他的来头？”钱世康理直气壮道。

捕快嘴角一阵抽搐，暗骂老天不公，凭什么这些脑袋空空的废物，出身都这么好？

凭什么乃公，就他娘的要伺候这些酒囊饭袋？

但很快，他就刻意压低声音，“钱公子，这位新来的县令，可是当朝六皇子啊。这消息几日前，就已经传开了，您一点风声都没听到吗？”

当朝六皇子？

钱世康顿时震惊地瞪了瞪眼，挺直的腰板，瞬间弯了下去，就连手指都有点抖了。

但嘴硬的毛病，却一点没改，“哼，皇子又如何？你见过哪个受宠的皇子，不是封王就藩的？”

“堂堂皇子，却被打发到这穷乡僻壤的鬼地方当县令，依本公子来看，这所谓的皇子，也不过尔尔。”

捕快无奈道：“钱公子，那是您不知道，这位六皇子有多无法无天。在皇城的时候，他不仅敢掀宰相孙女的裙底，就连自己的皇嫂都……”

“连嫂子都……”钱世康顿时满脸敬仰地看向张宁，连最硬的嘴，都有点软了，“这简直就是我……咳咳，这新来的县令，还真有点东西。”

“……”捕快只得假装没听见，继续说道，“换作其他皇子，这么胡作非为，被满朝文武弹劾，早就被废了，可他却只是被赶到此地做县令，钱公子可知这是何故？”

钱世康不假思索道：“因为他有个好爹。”

捕快：“……”

真他娘的酒囊饭袋，皇子们的爹，难道还能不是一个人不成？

“钱公子果然聪慧，这么迅速的判断，竟只差了毫厘。”捕快嘴上却道，“他是明德皇后的嫡子。”

The detective smiled bitterly and spread his hands, "Yes, but he is the county magistrate."

"County magistrate?" Qian Shikang was stunned and couldn't help but look back at Zhang Ning, his tone not as confident as before.

But he still spoke harshly and straightened his back unconsciously, "County, what's wrong with the county magistrate? Even if you are the county magistrate, when you come to this barren mountain county, you have to toast me!"

Wang Fa of the Qian Kingdom was surnamed Zhang.

But at least part of Wang Fa in Huangshan County must have the surname Qian.

Which new county magistrate, when arriving in Huangshan County, should not first go to the Qian family to pay homage to the dock?

The detective's eyes widened in disbelief, "Master Qian really doesn't know where this county magistrate is?"

"A mere county magistrate, why do I need to know his background?" Qian Shikang said confidently.

The corner of the detective's mouth twitched, and he cursed God for being unfair. How come these empty-headed losers have such good backgrounds?

Why do you think you have to wait for these wine sacks and rice sacks?

But soon, he deliberately lowered his voice, "Mr. Qian, this new county magistrate is the sixth prince of the current dynasty. This news has been spread a few days ago, haven't you heard anything about it?"

The sixth prince of the current dynasty?

Qian Shikang suddenly stared in shock, his straight back suddenly bent down, and even his fingers were shaking a little.

But his stubbornness has not changed at all, "Humph, so what about the prince? Have you ever seen a favored prince who either became a king or a vassal?"

"A noble prince was sent to this remote and remote place as a county magistrate. From my point of view, this so-called prince is nothing more than mediocre."

The policeman said helplessly: "Mr. Qian, you don't know how lawless this sixth prince is. When he was in the imperial city, he not only dared to lift the prime minister's granddaughter's skirt, but even his own imperial sister-in-law..."

"Even my sister-in-law..." Qian Shikang suddenly looked at Zhang Ning with admiration on his face, and even his toughest words softened, "This is simply me... Ahem, this new county magistrate really has something."

"..." The policeman had to pretend not to hear and continued, "Any other prince would have been impeached by the civil and military officials of the dynasty for such misbehavior and would have been deposed long ago, but he was just driven here to be the county magistrate. Does Mr. Qian know why?"

Qian Shikang said without hesitation: "Because he has a good father."

Detective: "..."

What a damn waste of money, how could the father of the princes be a human being?

"Young Master Qian is really smart. His quick judgment was only a hair's breadth away." The policeman said, "He is the legitimate son of Queen Mingde."
